summary: Browser redirect payload shipped as package main, targets end users not installers
details: The package's main entry is browser-only DOM code that constructs a full-screen iframe pointing at the hardcoded remote URL https://mfmz.wbcitf.cn/H.html?c=0gjr and appends it to document.body. There are no npm lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) and no Node-executable top-level code — the module references document/document.body, so requiring it in Node throws before any effect. Installing the package does not exfiltrate data, execute remote code, or persist anything on the installer's machine. However, any web page that bundles or includes this script will silently redirect visitors to the hardcoded.cn domain via a full-viewport iframe, which is consistent with malvertising/redirect-injection behavior against end users of the consuming site.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
